dedupe_keys.name: robod room level occupancy and building operation dataset

description: ROBOD gives indoor environmental conditions, Wi-Fi connected device counts, end-use energy (HVAC, lighting, plug loads and fans), HVAC operation and outdoor weather, with ground-truth occupant presence and counts, for five rooms in a university. It was deposited on figshare in July 2022 (seven versions, last updated September 2022) by Zeynep Duygu Tekler, Eikichi Ono, Yuzhen Peng, Sicheng Zhan, Bertrand Lasternas and Adrian Chong, whose data paper in Building Simulation lists them at the National University of Singapore in OpenAlex. The rooms are two lecture rooms of different sizes, an administrative office, a researchers' office and a student library space, monitored for 181 days at 5-minute resolution by heterogeneous sensors. Coverage: five rooms in one university setting. Access: one 4.5 MB zip on figshare. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: the building and its location are not named in the dataset record. Simulation uses: occupancy prediction, occupant behaviour models, HVAC control and energy forecasting benchmarks. Related records: PLEIAData, OfficeGraph and the Vienna office occupant dataset.
